story.title: About Mingo
story.belief: At Mingo Ice Cream, we believe everyone deserves to enjoy quality ice cream. After all, everybody loves ice cream.

history.title: History
history.kicker: Bringing a world of joy and fun since our humble beginnings in 2009
history.paragraphOne: Mingo Ice Cream started in 2009. Although our beginnings were humble, we brought traditional recipes from Asia to a wide range of dessert ice creams. Each recipe is thoughtfully adapted for different tastes while preserving its fresh, delicious character.
history.paragraphTwo: We put passion into every tub, cup and stick we make. Today, Mingo and our Rokka, Oasis and Fruitesia brands can be found across several countries in the region.
